note: Distance to a working benchmark (Constitution VI), not absolute truth.

der_total.note: DER is computed only over letters both sides agree on, so a base-letter misread is never also charged as a diacritic error. base_cer is CER with all diacritics stripped. The `all` pool includes low-confidence and recovered pages; `matched_only` is the clean-denominator figure and matches scripts/measure_der.py exactly. See docs/AGENTS.md §12 (spec 011).

diacritics.note: accuracy = density ratio (marks/base letter). Per-word counts are a lower bound on exactly-base-matched words only.
